info.title: SpaceFleet account API
info.description: The account API behind the SpaceFleet apps. Library contents are end-to-end encrypted and never leave the user's computer in clear: this API only ever carries ciphertext for them. Titles, posters and descriptions are not part of this API. Each login session may make 600 requests a minute (OPS-LIMIT-05); past that, any authenticated route answers 429 `rate_limited` with `Retry-After` before it runs.

get.description:
Server-Sent Events stream (`text/event-stream`) that emits library metadata updates. Use case: keep clients notified when a new snapshot version is available. Each event's data is the scalar status of `GET /library/db/meta` (version, snapshot version, hashes, last op, format versions), with an empty `snapshotHistory` and at most the newest entry of `opsHistory`, sent once on connect and again on every update, so its size does not grow with the library; a `ping` event is sent every 25 seconds and the stream closes after 5 minutes, so clients reconnect. A browser `EventSource` cannot set headers: it may pass the session token as `?token=` and the app as `?app=` instead of the `Authorization` and `x-space-app` headers.

post.summary: Get or assign a media's storage silo
post.description:
Returns the silo (storage gateway) holding one playable media, keyed by its client-minted `placementId`; the first call picks the silo (fewest user bytes, then a random pick weighted by free space and a quieter busy-times peak) and records it. Silo fill never refuses a new media; 503 `no_storage_capacity` means no activated, healthy silo is online (a silo awaiting activation never takes media, STOR-GATEWAY-13), and 503 `placement_silo_unavailable` that the media's recorded silo is offline or no longer takes data. Use case: uploads open their tunnel session on that silo and store objects as `media/<placementId>/<uuid>`. While a media move is copying the placement, answers 409 `placement_moving` (retryable); the client drops its cached placement and retries. With the stand-in provider the answer is 409 `billing_provider_standin`; while `GET /billing/status` reports `checkoutAllowed: false` the answer is 409 `subscription_active`.

post.summary: Go back to the free plan under the 14-day guarantee
post.description:
The legal withdrawal (ACCT-PLAN-10): counts on the day it is asked and is never refused for what the library stores. It holds every covered payment, stops the renewals and refuses new uploads until the refund (ACCT-PLAN-13). When the library already fits the free plan, the payments go back to the card now and the account goes to free; otherwise the user removes the excess and calls `POST /billing/guarantee/free/finish`, and at the latest 14 days after the request the server deletes the newest pieces above the free allowance, refunds and moves the account to free.
